verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents Audit Log Webhooks that stream audit events into your own infrastructure. Per the audit-log docs, every action in the admin application is logged, so subscribers receive a broad event feed. The evidence is a single brief mention, though, and covers only audit-log streaming. Missing for 10: dedicated feature/flag-change webhooks, event-type filtering, documented payload schemas or signing/retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
